say:1:1430104101:1.text: The most important thing about making a roast turkey is, of course, the fire!
say:1:1430104101:1.source_cn: 做烤鸡最重要的当然是火炉！

say:2:1430104102:1.text: In Brimstone Village, the only way to roast a turkey is to smother it in a furnace!
say:2:1430104102:1.source_cn: 在我们深岩村，火鸡只有用火炉闷烤这一种做法!

say:3:1430104103:1.text: Our furnaces here not only make high-quality weapons...
say:3:1430104103:1.source_cn: 我们这里的黏土和地热协作出的火炉，不仅能锻造优质的武器——

say:4:1430104104:1.text: ...we use them to cook our turkeys to a tender crisp. All the juices get locked inside.
say:4:1430104104:1.source_cn: 还能做出外皮微微焦脆，内里肉质鲜嫩且锁住油水的火鸡！
